description: Builds individual development plans and team training programs: sets a skills baseline, analyzes and prioritizes gaps against current and target roles, picks a blend of on-the-job, social and formal learning, and defines observable milestones and review dates. Use when a manager, employee or L&D lead asks for a development plan, IDP, upskilling or reskilling plan, skill gap analysis, career growth plan, or a training program for a team. Relies only on role frameworks, assessments and learning catalogs the user provides.
